comments: Sasha was an amazing host! Don't look any further. Her lovely apartment was spacious, tidy and welcoming. She went out of her way to make us feel at home and incredibly attentive. She was also very knowledgeable about the area and always eager to help. We loved staying with her and hope to visit again in the future! Top notch host, in a beautiful apartment and a fantastic location.
Terrific apartment, right in the heart of the best part of Toronto. Dimitri was very accommodating.
Vas was very kind, me and my father loved the place. I definitely will come again when my family visits from Korea next time.
Fantastic place to stay, great location and lovely host! Shona went out of her way to help us whenever needed and the spa she has is off the main roads, quiet and clean.

Katya's place is perfect for someone like myself -- on business in the city. It has a separate entrance so I was not disturbing anyone. The rooms were very clean. Katya left food and drinks for my use. The kitchen is nice and easily available. The washer and dryer are right there, although I did not need them this trip. The bathroom had everything one would expect, as well as a choice of shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. Internet worked well. Street parking was easy. I'd recommend this for a single business traveller or even someone just wanting to vacation. Close to Down town, and close to subway, park, and as well as stores and restaurants. -mike.

Jenn and Michael's place was the perfect landing pad! They've mastered this airbnb thing—great clear communication, a bunch of resources for us to check out, and a super cute, fun space! I would absolutely stay with them again. Thanks again, especially for the firewood & flexible check out time!
The location was amazing! Host had done a amazing job with keeping the place clean and up to date! Nice and quite getaway! Loved it !

Everything about this place was perfect: the location, the house, the hosts, etc. We walked to everything and didn't need to worry about transportation or getting lost on it as newcomers. Doug and Michelle let us have our space, but still maintained that contact to make sure we knew they were there if we needed anything. We'd absolutely stay here again if we come back to visit Toronto!

We had a great stay at Hyla's place. It was super cute, comfortable and located on one of the best streets in Toronto. Complete with all of the amenities one could need. Hyla was very responsive and helpful. Would highly recommend it!
Melanie’s place is awesome, It’s close to most of the famous places in downtown. We enjoyed the time spent there while visiting Toronto.

Judith was the best a host can get! Our flights got cancelled due to severe weather and we decided to drive the 600 miles in a blizzard to reach Toronto. Judith was in touch with us throughout the way and when we arrived so late, she waited up for us as she was worried for our drive. All in all, one of the best host I’ve ever met and her location is right on the outskirts of town so it was so accessible to get in and out of downtown.

Jerry's place is absolutely gorgeous. It looks just like the picture. Floor to ceiling glass... very modern! And if you want to see downtown Toronto, this is an ideal place to stay. It is close to just about everything. Jerry was an excellent host. He responded to my inquiries very quickly and always offered to help. I would definitely stay with him again!

Great room in a great location. The unit is really spacious with a big comfortable bed. The location is fantastic. Kensington market is charming and eclectic and a quick walk to the University of Toronto. Highly recommended.

We had a great time here. The hosts were extremely friendly and accommodating and rearranged their cleaners so that we could have a later check out (which made all the difference to our 26 hour journey!). The apartment is beautifully furnished and so comfortable. The pub downstairs (run by the same people) has very friendly staff and a great atmosphere. This is a great place to stay and I wholeheartedly recommend it.

Amazing place! Full amenities! Has everything a traveler needs and is about 30 min away from downtown stuff with out much traffic! Plus Sarah is so sweet and provides so many goodies and wonderful products, breakfast items, and decor :) a thing to note I’m 6’3” and everywhere was a couple inches above my head but hit my head on the door way a couple times because I forgot to duck. But such a comfy and cozy home away from home, and the bed is SOOOO comfy! WiFi is a little spotty at times from the bedroom but worked great everywhere else and the bathroom had the best signal lol and she has a tv with Netflix and everything else needed to just relax or binge your favorite show. Will defiantly come back if ever in Toronto!
Clean and safe environment, washer dryer on site however noticed it was being used as a storage space at the time although it did not affect us during our stay.

Had an excellent time staying here! The host was extremely welcoming and made the experience amazing. The house was very beautiful and everything was super clean. Would definitely recommend to others!

I absolutely loved Brian's place the walkability, the shower the bed, it was clean the neighbors are helpful and friendly would definitely stay again thank you for everything. Auntie's and uncle's at the corner has really good food. Hope to visit again.

A very nice apartment with a terrific view. Surprisingly quiet, considering it's just a couple minutes away from a subway downtown. The description and reviews are accurate. Konstantin answered quickly when we needed his help.
I highly recommend this spot! Tanis, the host is responsive, accommodating and helpful. The home was clean, full of amenities and very comfortable. Plus, the location is superb!
This penthouse space is stunning, providing luxury decor and stunning views of the Toronto metropolis. Highly recommend and would definitely book again.

Very clean and quiet. The family are absolutely wonderful and will welcome you with open arms and offer you food and to join them in their home. Very friendly and kind folks. I would recommend staying here if you're friendly and outgoing.

Sarah's house is located in a cozy neighborhood with easy access to public transportation and shopping malls. She provided seamless check-in experience, and was nice enough to let my friends (who travelled multiple hours to visit me in Toronto) stay over for couple of nights. I'd highly recommend Sarah's place!

Wonderful space. Getting into the space was no problem. Going down the stairs into the space reminded me of a New York (Queens) listing we stayed at but MUCH larger. The air was amazing to step into after traveling all day. Very comfortable bed.

This is a pristine second floor apartment that provides a stylish oasis of tranquility and comfort. Welcome touches included some fruit placed for our arrival and a responsive host. For those wishing to stay in this part of Toronto it is an ideal choice

This house is a little gym. It was absolutely spotless and everything was just as pictured in the ad - fabulous style. It was well appointed with an amazing location and Christine was an absolute joy to work with. She was super responsive and really friendly. We will definitely be coming back to this house.

A great apartment which is exactly as shown in the photos. We stayed with our two young children, and it was large enough, with adequate bedding, towels and kitchen utensils etc. Very nice also to have the outside space to have an evening drink. Hyla is extremely fast to respond to queries and the check in was seamless. We know he neighbourhood well, and were so happy to be able to stay here. If you’ve never been to Toronto this apartment is located in the perfect introductory neighbourhood!
Thank’s Erik for everything! We had very good expierence - living place and backyard was amazing, especially grill, outdoor TV and jacuzzi! Recomend for everyone!
Locarion was great a little plaza mall across street and most places were only 15 min drive away some even closer . If you need anything they are happy to help

This Airbnb is amazing, it has all the amenities you need for a short or a long stay and is very spacious and clean. We stayed 2 months and really enjoyed it, you totally forget you're in a basement. The location is one of the best, close to a supermarket, restaurants, bars and public transport. You can also walk to High Park, which is very nice to take walks and see some nature. Maria and Tom are the most amazing people, they are really nice and communication is easy.
The place is clean and located close to a lot of shops, stores, and entertainment. The parking space and the coffee shop downstairs were great perks. Overall, we were very happy with our stay.
Steve was a fantastic host. Very communicative and hospitable. The place was very clean and the check-in was seamless. Highly recommend for anyone who is visiting Toronto as a place to crash.
This place is great. Very Quiet! Highly recommended. Ideal location. Good security. Host is very responsive. Thank you so much!

Great condo, in the absolute best location! Next to everything you could need and more! Place was stocked up above and beyond some snacks in the cupboards, not just laundry detergent but he had the scent beads aswell which was a nice touch, and the bathroom both had different types of shampoo, conditioner, body wash and face wash/lotions!
Enjoyed my stay here & Roshanak was very kind, I would recommend this accommodation.

This is a great Airbnb if you're looking to explore the Greater Toronto Area, and even Toronto itself. The kitchen and amenities are definitely sufficient for a weeks stay and for even longer stays. You can hear the footsteps from upstairs, so it might not be ideal for very light sleepers. There is a single bathroom which is quite small, so keep that in mind. The smaller bedroom gets quite hot and stuffy overnight. There's a grocery store right across the street which was very helpful. WiFi cut out a few times so not the best spot for WFH. Overall a great stay 4/5

Wonderful experience with Keir's apartment. Excellent location that has Loblaws only one block away. The room is super clean and have all the things that you want! Keir is very responsible and reply messages timely. Recommend to anyone who wants visit downtown Toronto!

Trini and Adrien are two wonderful hosts. They are very helpful and generous. It was a fantastic time for us to spend with these two hosts. As soon as it is possible for us to travel to Toronto again, we will not hesitate for a second and stay with Adrien and Trini again. It was our pleasure to be there as guests. We appreciate it very much. I can only strongly recommend this Airbnb.

I enjoyed my stay in Toronto.Amy's place was immaculate and very comfortable. Check in was effortless and I loved walking around the neighborhood. Transportation was close by and I took advantage of a couple of Amy's recommendations: an excellent cafe down the block and a charming french bistro with delicious food and excellent wine. Highly recommend!
Very nice location, parking permit from the citi is expensive to me, but not that bad. The place even has a small kitchen stove, which can be useful.

The property was well presented, well equipped and enjoyable to stay in. A great location with easy walking distance to all GreekTown & Rivervale had to offer. The location is lovely and quiet. The district has lots to offer in terms of restaurants, cafe's and bars. We enjoyed coffee at Schmooz on Pape, a lovely family run cafe serving great coffee. We really appreciated the assistance of our host Aleksa, who provided us great support. All in all we had a very relaxing time at the property.

Trinis & Adriens home is just perfect for a stay in Toronto, we were absolutely satisfied with our choice: - the location of their home is central - the home is very clean & pretty - the hosts are so courteous, we felt like home just after a view minutes We will definetly come back!
A decent place to stay in with easy access to groceries and restaurants. We had a wonderful experience living in Svetlana's place .It is clean and cozy with well prepared supplies.

This is a wonderful place, very clean and Yan is a responsive host. It’s a quiet and safe neighbourhood. It’s got everything you need to cook and unwind. Huge tv!! I recommend Yan and his Airbnb to anyone. Thanks Yan!!
Daniels place had everything we needed. It was close to lots of great stuff. Easy check in as well.

Zoila was a great host and extremely kind and responsive. the house was immaculate and airy. the rooms were a great temperature and the beds were really comfortable. the area is far from a lot of touristy areas, but there's loads of cycle stations nearby 10/10 would recommend :)
Only stayed one night but the place was exactly as described and looked like the pictures. Michael was super helpful and always responsive. Nice quiet location. Would definitely recommend
The condo was everything we expected. Great location. It is expensive, but worth the money to be within waking distance of many attractions. We would definitely stay there again.
No problems during our stay. Well kept place, friendly host. AC was much appreciated in the Toronto heat!
Mark is a great host, very helpful and flexible. The location is amazing and close to every spot in downtown. Would definitely recommend to someone seeking a few days being close to everything.

Great location for a wonderful stay The apartment was clean with all the amenities that we could’ve asked for and more And the host was nothing short of amazingly helpful during our entire stay Will definitely consider again for any future visits

We had a wonderful stay at Mirella’s condo in downtown Toronto. The unit was clean and furnished with all necessities and more. The location is fantastic and Mirella is a very responsive and generous host.

When we entered in, there was a foul odor and stains on the bedroom wall. The temperature control in the condo would cool down only temporarily, when we set it to 69-72 degrees farenheit and so we would wake up not so comfortable. The TV had connectivity issues. We did the initial troubleshooting but it still did not work. We brought it the Lucas's notice and we were told to reset the TV and so we gave up. We are here on a vacation and not to troubleshoot and help fix things ourselves. Luca was quite responsive but we expected our issues to be resolved.
This was a beautiful, clean, and comfortable space that I would stay in again! The host was very responsive and helpful. Thank you Jonathan!
Place was clean and just as described, kn a convenient location just a few blocks is from union station
The place was in a great location with great views. Having a parking spot also added to the value. I highly recommend this place.
What a great stay!!! We had an amazing time...the place truly feels like home and Sina was always available to answer questions at a moment's notice. Would definitely stay again!
Great pad in a nice neighborhood close to transport and excellent food stops! Thanks Brandon for an excellent stay
Peaceful and beautiful place, friendly owners. Everything was as described. Clean and useful kitchen, even some spices were present. Comfortable bedroom and bathroom. High recommended place.

Amazing spot to spend a few days away from home. Chyleen has outdone herself in making you feel welcomed right away! Every detail has been carefully thought out and the place is spotless! As a cleaner, I look for and appreciate this important detail! All the beds are very comfortable and the rooms have ample room for your luggage. We will definitely recommend Chyleen's place to friends, and will keep this as a favorite place to stay when traveling to TO.

Kevin’s space was perfect for my mini birthday staycation. It was in a quiet area but not far at all from restaurants, lounges & more! The home was exactly as pictured & I would book again next time I’m in Toronto!

Great location with fantastic restaurants and easy access to subway for travel downtown. Communication was good with Aleksa. The home does need some TLC with the back deck needing some attention and interior blind in master bedroom needs to be replaced. Best to print your parking pass prior to getting to this location. Overall, great location in a fantastic neighborhood. The location was clean upon my arrival (bathroom and Kitchen was spotless).
Absolutely lovely, well equipped, clean apartment. Very central yet extremely quiet. Daod was very helpful and responsive.

Great stay at a great location! Within walking distance to everything Toronto has to offer. Condo cleanliness was only average and could have been a bit cleaner. Overall enjoyed our stay and Ardavan was very helpful and informative.

We had a great time at the apartment, apartment was great and perfect location, close to a lot of attractions like aquarium, arena and CN Tower. Also perfectly located close to the big convention center

Saskia was a such amazing host! The place was amazing, complete for a long stay, clean and well prepared,we felt like home for 2 months. She always was so kind, proactive. Also, the neighborhood is great! A lot of cafes, restaurants and other close. Really recommended.
The room is very clean. However, the street feels somewhat unsafe, and it can get a bit noisy due to a nearby nightclub.

Spot was super easy to find and check-in was very straightforward. We were surrounded by great food and fun quirky shops. The deck was a great place to unwind after walking around all day! Although on the weekends the DJ at the restaurant underneath can be a little loud, didn't bother us but something to note. It was quiet on the week nights
Excellent location, easy drive to Finch Station and plenty of parking there. Huge bedroom and excellent hosts.
Great apartment, and most importantly, thick walls so you don’t hear neighbours. I’m a light sleeper and had no problem. With noise, which I do everywhere else. Soundproof! Great location!!!!

Place was awesome, close to transit and restaurants. The host had a smoke with us and gave us recommendations, was very welcoming and responsive. Would highly recommend. WiFi is included. Only thing if you're taller than 6'2 with good posture the roof can be a bit low in certain spots.

Lovely staying here literally just steps from the CN tower and surrounding attractions! it's THE prefect spot if your going to Toronto for a weekend away. we parked the car and was able to walk/ rent bicycles to tour all over town. Sujhan is a great host, his place is well taken care of. clean and comfortable! this place is exactly how it's described in the listing!! Will book again. p.s love the whiteboard for leaving quotes on!

Caroline's place is in a great location - peaceful and private but only a 8-10min walk to shops and the TTC for public transport. The house had all the listed amenities, looked exactly like the pictures, and we really enjoyed our stay!

An amazing home - beautifully situated close to downtown, transit and restaurants. An incredibly cozy, clean living space with room for several guests. Christian was lovely to correspond with! Will book again when I'm back in the city!

The place was clean, conveniently located, and had everything I needed. Nothing extravagant, but lovely for 2 nights. You can hear the guests upstairs quite clearly but it did'nt cause any major problems for me!

We stayed at Aleskas place when we were in town for a concert! This place was very well located, an easy subway ride to the city centre. The place we clean and looked just like the pictures. We all had a great stay and would return.
Loved our stay here! Right by the bus stop that takes you to the subway which takes you into downtown Toronto! It was perfect!
Very charming place. Absolutely stunning inside with high ceilings and the feeling of being transported into the past. So much character and very clean with a great use of space. What a gem.

We stayed at Bwanka’s place while attending a Raptors game, which was perfect for this event as it was steps from Scotiabank arena making it easy to get there and back! Very clean, nice little space. Easy to access as Bwanka provided detailed instructions and was quick to answer any questions I had! Will be staying here again!

Saroj’s place was great. We had a couple of discrepancies on the listing description not exactly matching the booking which I did reach out to Saroj and she was able to fix and update promptly. The place is very clean, with a cozy feel. Definitely good for family travel, the baby crib was a huge plus for us traveling with our 1 year old. Location is good but keep in mind with traffic to get to downtown Toronto area it’s at least an hour and about 20mins without traffic. Overall great stay! Thank you

Our stay at David’s was nothing short of perfect. A fantastic stay for a couple, we loved the artistic yet pristinely clean space, the walkability and location, and felt right at home immediately. Thank you David, hope to come back and visit again!

My stay at William's place was great. I used it as a base for a few nights while getting ready to move back to Toronto after some time in Europe. It was ideally located to shops and restaurants on St. Clair West and had a great office and sleeping space. The place was quiet and the snacks that William left were also appreciated!

We had a wonderful stay, and sad to leave! The place is beautifully decorated, comfortable and cozy. Lara and Larissa are both warm & welcoming hosts. Do not miss the incredible views from the top floor gym and wrap around balcony!

TianShi’s place was absolutely spotless! The attention to detail was impressive, from the immaculate cleanliness to the thoughtful touches throughout. The clear instructions made check-in a breeze, and the local recommendations were incredibly helpful. I’d definitely stay here again!
Harry was great and the unit matched the description. Parking was easy . We enjoyed our stay. Would recommend to family and friends.

You will be in one of the best spots in the city if you stay here. Easy walking along the vibrant neighbourhoods bound by College and Dundas Streets. At a perfect juncture for transit elsewhere. Although on a busy street, the apartment was perfectly quiet for a nighttime sleep after our time out on the town. The apartment is older. Has some character. It was comfortable for our short stay. Tastefully decorated and clean. Just in need of a little updating in the kitchen and bathroom. If you’re a taller person, you might find the single beds a bit short. But the larger bedroom has a massive, very comfortable bed. Hosts were quick to respond to messages. Overall, we were pretty happy with our stay and would stay again if we had other events in the city we’d want to stay a couple of days for.

My family had the pleasure of staying at Jonathan’s place, and it was nothing short of perfect! From the moment we arrived, the check-in process was seamless. The home was spotless, beautifully decorated, and equipped with all the amenities we needed for a comfortable stay. The location was ideal, with easy access to local attractions, restaurants, and public transport. I especially enjoyed the balcony with a view, which made our stay even more enjoyable. Communication with Jonathan was excellent; he was quick to respond to any questions. We truly felt at home during our stay and can't recommend this place enough! We will definitely be returning for another visit. Thank you for an unforgettable experience!
We spent two nights in the apartment. Clean, cozy, fully equipped. Azat is charming and very available. Highly recommended.
Had a great stay, everything was super clean and the apartment is in a great location! Thank you!

The space is cozy, everything was very clean. We were greeted with some little gifts, which was a very kind gesture. The hostess was extremely helpful and always responded very quickly. The neighborhood is great: quiet, beautiful and just a 10-minute walk from the subway. We highly recommend this place. We had a great experience!

We had a great 4-night stay at Jie’s with my wife, daughter, and me. The apartment was perfect and exactly as described. The amenities in the building were fantastic, including valet parking, a pool, hot tub, sauna, gym, sun deck, and garden patio. The neighborhood had beautiful shops and galleries, trendy restaurants, great sweet treats, and a Whole Foods around the corner. The location could not be beat for access to metro stops, nice walks, shopping, and the Royal Ontario Museum. And Jie was a great host. She was very responsive to any questions we had. We will definitely return the next time we are in Toronto!
Great location with amazing views of the city. very comfy beds. Close to lots of bars and restaurants, and tangerine bikes right outside. perfect base to explore Toronto

This place is great, and Emma truly made the stay exceptional. Her communication was excellent, and she was incredibly helpful. I would absolutely recommend staying here and plan to book again next time I'm in Toronto!
This was the perfect spot for my long weekend. James made the whole process incredibly easy. The space is just a few minutes from so many things to do. I would certainly stay here again.

Had a great stay. Large and comfortable with a huge kitchen that we sadly didn't take advantage of. Location was quiet, pretty, and close to transit--and even closer to delicious Tibetan food. Leslie Jill was responsive and helpful with a few questions we had. The place is probably a bit dark in winter, but in summer it stayed nice and cool. We were worried about the lack of AC during a heat wave, but we were comfortable even during a string of 30º days.

Christian was a very responsive and helpful host with terrific recommendations and a beautiful home. I stayed here with my wife and two children (6 and 3 years old), but I would probably not bring the littles back, only because there are a lot of nice pieces of decor that I was worried about getting broken. I would absolutely come here with my kids if they were older and wouldn’t hesitate to come back with my wife alone.

Very clean, quiet and comfortable place to stay in the downtown of Toronto. The accommodation and leaving were easy, all was written in the instructions that were sent to us. There were so many places nearby to have lunch and dinner. We almost didn't use the car because more of our visited places were reachable by foot. I would stay there again when I visit Toronto.

Fan's appartement was as described. It was clean, with a nice view and close to coronation park and the lakeshore. Fan was responsive and the conversation was flawless. Great place for a weekend in Toronto if you like the Fort York area. A+

The location was fabulous, right next to the Roger’s Centre. Walkable to numerous restaurants and bars, couple of grocery stores. 10 min walk to Union Station to access the train to and from the airport. Very nice roof top pool. Absolutely will return when watching the Blue Jays play.

Perfect stay! Tai’s place is in a great location, well decorated with a nice bed a great TV. Kitchen very well setup and stocked. Tai is one of our favourite hosts ever and was responsive, kind, proactive and so helpful. Would highly recommend staying with Tai
